batman.name: Batman
batman.title: THE DARK KNIGHT
batman.subtitle: THE DETECTIVE WHO TURNED GRIEF INTO A MISSION
batman.storyLeft: Bruce Wayne watched his parents die in Crime Alley and turned that wound into a lifelong vow. He trained across the world, studied every angle of fear and crime, then came home to Gotham as a symbol criminals could not ignore.
batman.storyRight: Batman succeeds by outthinking enemies who often outgun him. He plans for the impossible, trusts the evidence, and keeps standing when the city has every reason to fall apart.

versions.quote: It's not who I am underneath, but what I do that defines me.

villains.name: The Joker
villains.front: Anarchy with a grin. The Joker tests whether Batman can protect a city that keeps reinventing madness.
villains.back: Every appearance turns into a moral stress test for Gotham's protector and the line he refuses to cross.

villains.name: Bane
villains.front: Bane is the strategist who proves Batman can be beaten physically and mentally at the same time.
villains.back: Knightfall made Bane part of Batman's myth because he exposed the cost of carrying a city alone.

timeline.title: First appearance
timeline.text: Batman debuts in Detective Comics #27 and reshapes crime fiction in caped form.

timeline.title: Year One
timeline.text: Frank Miller's origin focuses the legend on detective work, corruption, and discipline.

timeline.title: Knightfall
timeline.text: Bane breaks Batman, forcing Gotham's protector to confront his own limits.

timeline.title: The New 52
timeline.text: The Court of Owls era pushes Batman deeper into conspiracy and urban myth.

teamup.title: World's Finest
teamup.text: Strategy meets hope. Batman gives the plan, Superman gives the lift, and the world gets a team that can handle anything from a street-level crisis to a cosmic invasion.

origin: Bruce Wayne's origin is a study in grief weaponized into discipline. After the murder of Thomas and Martha Wayne, he committed himself to a life built around detection, endurance, and fear as a tool against criminals.
He did not become Batman because he wanted power. He became Batman because Gotham needed a symbol that could survive corruption, mob power, and supervillains without losing its nerve.
powers: Batman has no superhuman powers, and that is the point. His strength comes from peak physical training, forensic reasoning, planning, infiltration, and an unmatched ability to stay three moves ahead.
The utility belt, bat-gadgets, vehicles, and contingency plans are extensions of his mind. He fights like a detective, a soldier, and a strategist folded into one.
storylines: Year One defines his early war on crime. The Long Halloween turns Gotham into a detective mystery. Knightfall breaks his body, while The Court of Owls reminds him that the city has hidden rulers older than his mission.
No Man's Land, Hush, and countless modern arcs show the same thing: Batman is at his most interesting when Gotham itself becomes the adversary.
allies: Alfred Pennyworth anchors Bruce with honesty and dry wit. Gordon gives him a public ally inside the system. Robin, Batgirl, Nightwing, and the wider Bat-Family turn the mission from solitary obsession into a living network.
His Justice League alliances prove that the man who works best alone still understands trust when the stakes rise.
legacy: Batman set the modern template for grounded superheroes: trauma, consequence, urban atmosphere, and a hero whose brilliance is as important as his punch.
He remains one of comics' most flexible icons because every era can ask a different question of him: how much pain can a person carry, and still choose not to become the thing they fight?
funFacts: Batman first appeared in Detective Comics #27 in 1939.
The Bat-Signal is as much a symbol of trust as it is a warning.
His greatest weapon is often the thing criminals forget to fear: patience.

trivia.question: Which comic famously introduced Batman's origin in a definitive modern form?
trivia.explanation: Batman: Year One is the landmark modern retelling of Bruce Wayne's early years.

trivia.question: What makes Batman most dangerous in a room full of metahumans?
trivia.explanation: He wins by preparation, not by powers.

superman.name: Superman
superman.title: MAN OF STEEL
superman.subtitle: HOPE GIVEN A HUMAN FACE
superman.storyLeft: Kal-El was sent from Krypton to survive the end of his world and was raised in Smallville as Clark Kent. The Kents taught him that power only matters if it is guided by compassion.
superman.storyRight: Superman represents what happens when a godlike being chooses restraint, empathy, and public service. He does not rule the world; he protects it and tries to inspire it to do better.

versions.quote: You will give the people of Earth an ideal to strive towards.

villains.name: Lex Luthor
villains.front: Lex turns intellect into ego, then into an argument against alien power and public trust.
villains.back: The rivalry matters because it is a duel over what humanity should admire: compassion or control.

villains.name: Brainiac
villains.front: Brainiac threatens not just Metropolis but the idea that knowledge should be used with empathy.
villains.back: He gives Superman an enemy that is cold, brilliant, and impossible to intimidate.

timeline.title: First appearance
timeline.text: Superman launches in Action Comics #1 and defines the superhero archetype.

timeline.title: Cinematic hope
timeline.text: The Reeve films make the world believe a man can fly.

timeline.title: Death and Return
timeline.text: The Death of Superman arc proves that the symbol matters even when the man falls.

timeline.title: All-Star voice
timeline.text: All-Star Superman turns the character into a perfect statement on hope and legacy.

teamup.title: World's Finest
teamup.text: Batman supplies the contingency plan. Superman supplies the impossible lift. Together they balance inspiration with realism.

moves.special: fires heat vision at full power
moves.guard: anchors the battlefield with calm force

origin: Superman's origin is built on two homes: Krypton, the world he lost, and Earth, the world that raised him. Jor-El and Lara save their son by sending him away, while Jonathan and Martha Kent teach him how to become a good man.
The entire myth works because Clark Kent is not a disguise for weakness. He is the daily proof that immense power can coexist with humility.
powers: Under a yellow sun, Superman becomes one of the most powerful beings in comics. Flight, super strength, speed, invulnerability, heat vision, and sensory powers are only the beginning of what Kryptonian biology can do.
His most important power is restraint. The story only works when he is strong enough to solve almost anything, but wise enough to choose the solution that preserves lives and hope.
storylines: The Death of Superman and its aftermath turned him into a cultural event. Kingdom Come reframed him as a moral ideal in a broken future. All-Star Superman distilled the character into one of comics' purest reflections on hope.
More recent stories keep returning to the same core question: how does a near-perfect hero remain human, relatable, and compassionate while the world constantly demands more?
allies: Lois Lane keeps Clark honest. Jimmy Olsen keeps him grounded in the messiest, funniest corners of Metropolis. The Justice League lets him be the first responder to cosmic disasters without losing his humanity.
The Super-Family and the Kent family ensure that Superman's life is not only about what he can lift, but who he listens to.
legacy: Superman is the blueprint for heroic optimism. He made it possible to imagine superheroes as public symbols rather than just vigilantes or adventurers.
Every generation revisits him because the world always needs a version of hope that is visible, generous, and strong enough to be credible.
funFacts: Superman first appeared in Action Comics #1 in 1938.
Clark Kent's glasses are not the real disguise; the persona is.
He is most compelling when his compassion feels more powerful than his fists.

trivia.question: What city does Superman protect as his main home base?
trivia.explanation: Metropolis is the bright city that pairs naturally with Superman's hopeful image.

trivia.question: Which symbol best defines Superman's myth across eras?
trivia.explanation: Superman endures because he stands for hope first.

ironman.name: Iron Man
ironman.title: THE INVINCIBLE IRON MAN
ironman.subtitle: GENIUS, BILLIONAIRE, AND THE MAN WHO TURNED PANIC INTO FLIGHT
ironman.storyLeft: Tony Stark was a weapons billionaire who had to look directly at the consequences of his own industry. Captured and badly wounded, he built the first armor to survive, then kept building because survival was never the final goal.
ironman.storyRight: Iron Man is an arc of growth through invention, accountability, and sacrifice. Tony's brilliance makes him powerful; his willingness to change makes him heroic.

versions.quote: The suit and I are one.

villains.name: Whiplash
villains.front: Whiplash turns Stark's own technology culture into a personal vendetta.
villains.back: The rivalry works because it asks whether invention creates safety or just more elegant violence.

villains.name: Ultron
villains.front: Ultron is the nightmare that says Tony's logic can survive without his ethics.
villains.back: That makes Ultron one of Stark's sharpest mirrors: progress without conscience.

timeline.title: First appearance
timeline.text: Iron Man debuts in Tales of Suspense #39 and turns industrial tech into superhero mythology.

timeline.title: MCU ignition
timeline.text: The first Iron Man film launches the Marvel Cinematic Universe with a gamble that pays off instantly.

timeline.title: Demon in a Bottle
timeline.text: One of Marvel's essential stories confronts Tony's flaws without pretending genius solves everything.

timeline.title: Endgame
timeline.text: Tony closes the Infinity Saga with a sacrifice that redefines the character's legacy.

teamup.title: Mentor and student
teamup.text: Tony gives Peter resources, standards, and occasional sarcasm. Peter gives Tony the reminder that heroism still needs wonder.

origin: Tony Stark built his first armor in captivity after a life-changing injury forced him to see the consequences of his own weapons empire. The escape suit became a turning point that transformed him from arms dealer to armored protector.
His origin is powerful because it is not about destiny. It is about responsibility, shame, and the decision to improve the world using the same brilliance that helped create the problem.
powers: Iron Man's strength comes from engineering. Powered armor gives him flight, heavy artillery, AI support, sensor suites, battlefield adaptation, and specialized loadouts for almost any threat.
Tony's real superpower is iteration. He treats every failure like a design brief and every victory like a prototype for the next impossible challenge.
storylines: Demon in a Bottle remains the essential Tony Stark story because it forces him to face self-destruction. Armor Wars turns his tech into a liability he must clean up. Civil War places his ethics under public scrutiny. Endgame rewards his growth with sacrifice.
Each major arc asks the same question differently: can Tony stay heroic when the world keeps rewarding the worst parts of his personality?
allies: Pepper Potts, James Rhodes, and the Avengers are the people who keep Tony honest when his ego tries to outrun his judgment. Friday, Jarvis, and the wider Stark circle turn the suit into a team effort rather than a solo fantasy.
His best alliances work because people challenge him, not because they flatter him.
legacy: Iron Man modernized the idea of the technological superhero. He made armor feel like a character in itself and helped define the sleek, high-tech side of the Marvel universe.
The MCU elevated Tony Stark into a global icon of charisma and sacrifice, but the comic version remains just as important: a flawed genius trying to be worthy of his own inventions.
funFacts: Iron Man first appeared in Tales of Suspense #39 in 1963.
The armor has taken hundreds of forms, from bulky prototypes to elegant nano-tech designs.
Tony's best stories are usually the ones where his brilliance cannot outrun his conscience.

trivia.question: What powered Tony Stark's first life-saving prototype?
trivia.explanation: The arc reactor was the core that kept Tony alive and powered the first armor.

trivia.question: Which storyline is a classic Tony Stark character study?
trivia.explanation: Demon in a Bottle is a landmark exploration of Tony's flaws and accountability.

spiderman.name: Spider-Man
spiderman.title: YOUR FRIENDLY NEIGHBORHOOD SPIDER-MAN
spiderman.subtitle: POWERED BY RESPONSIBILITY, HUMOR, AND A LOT OF BAD LUCK
spiderman.storyLeft: Peter Parker was bitten by a radioactive spider and got power before he understood responsibility. That mistake and Uncle Ben's death made him the hero who can never separate saving people from paying a personal price.
spiderman.storyRight: Spider-Man works because he is brilliant, funny, anxious, and still willing to swing back into danger. He is the hero of the late homework, the bad day, and the impossible save.

versions.quote: I'm just a friendly neighborhood Spider-Man.
With great power comes great responsibility.

villains.name: Green Goblin
villains.front: Norman Osborn turns wealth, obsession, and madness into Spider-Man's most personal tragedy machine.
villains.back: The Goblin matters because he knows exactly where Peter hurts.

villains.name: Doc Ock
villains.front: Otto Octavius weaponizes brilliance and resentment, making Spider-Man fight a scientist who thinks he is the superior mind.
villains.back: Doc Ock stories are so strong because they turn the battle into a debate over who deserves to wear the hero's body or symbol.

timeline.title: First appearance
timeline.text: Spider-Man debuts in Amazing Fantasy #15 and rewrites what a teenage superhero can be.

timeline.title: Kraven's Last Hunt
timeline.text: One of Marvel's darkest Spider-Man stories explores identity, mortality, and resilience.

timeline.title: Spider-Verse
timeline.text: The multiverse expands Spider-Man into a legacy bigger than one person.

timeline.title: Across the Spider-Verse
timeline.text: Miles and Peter continue pushing the idea that responsibility can evolve across generations.

teamup.title: Mentor and student
teamup.text: Tony gives Peter a framework and advanced tech. Peter gives Tony the kind of hopeful energy he often forgets to protect.

moves.guard: dodges into a webbed evasive stance

origin: Peter Parker's life changed the moment a radioactive spider turned a smart, awkward teenager into someone powerful enough to help people and scared enough to get it wrong. Uncle Ben's death taught him that power without responsibility is a disaster waiting to happen.
Spider-Man's origin remains powerful because it blends science, guilt, humor, and adolescence in a way that never ages out of relevance.
powers: Spider-Man combines wall-crawling, superhuman agility, enhanced strength, web-shooting ingenuity, and a spider-sense that warns him before danger lands. His intellect is just as important as the powers.
He builds his own web fluid, improvises constantly, and fights like somebody who survives by instinct and creativity as much as by muscle.
storylines: The original Lee and Ditko stories established the responsibility mantra. Kraven's Last Hunt pushed the character into psychological depth. Spider-Verse turned his myth into a whole multiverse. Superior Spider-Man and related arcs tested what happens when identity is challenged from the inside.
Peter's greatest stories usually work because they balance joke, heartbreak, and sacrifice in the same breath.
allies: Mary Jane, Aunt May, the Fantastic Four, Miles Morales, and the wider Marvel community all reinforce the idea that Spider-Man is never truly alone, even when he feels that way.
His support system matters because the character is strongest when the audience sees how much he gives up to keep showing up.
legacy: Spider-Man is the archetypal relatable superhero. He made comics feel personal, urban, and emotionally accessible to a broader audience.
Every generation gets its own Spider-Man because the core idea is timeless: growing up is hard, but responsibility can still be heroic and fun.
funFacts: Spider-Man first appeared in Amazing Fantasy #15 in 1962.
He was one of the first major teenage superheroes to headline a title on his own.
His mask is iconic because it lets anyone imagine themselves behind it.

trivia.question: Which idea defines Spider-Man more than any web gadget?
trivia.explanation: Spider-Man is built on the responsibility lesson.

trivia.question: What kind of warning system does Spider-Man rely on in a fight?
trivia.explanation: Spider-sense is his early-warning reflex that makes him feel impossible to ambush.

wonderwoman.name: Wonder Woman
wonderwoman.title: DIANA OF THEMYSCIRA
wonderwoman.subtitle: TRUTH, COMPASSION, AND WARRIOR GRACE
wonderwoman.storyLeft: Diana was raised among the Amazons of Themyscira, trained in combat, diplomacy, and compassion before stepping into the world of men as its champion. Depending on the era, her origin shifts in detail, but her purpose stays constant: she brings truth into spaces built on war and fear.
wonderwoman.storyRight: Wonder Woman is not just a warrior. She is a bridge between myth and humanity, proving that mercy and strength are not opposites when they are guided by conviction.

versions.quote: I will fight for those who cannot fight for themselves.
All the world is waiting for you.

villains.name: Ares
villains.front: Ares personifies the seduction of conflict and the myth that war is inevitable.
villains.back: He matters because Wonder Woman's mission is fundamentally anti-war without being naive.

villains.name: Cheetah
villains.front: Cheetah is speed, envy, and ferocity turned against Diana's ideals.
villains.back: The rivalry is tragic because it often pits compassion against corruption from within.

timeline.title: First appearance
timeline.text: Wonder Woman arrives in All Star Comics #8 and becomes a pillar of the DC Trinity.

timeline.title: A cultural icon
timeline.text: The television era makes Diana a mainstream symbol of strength and justice.

timeline.title: New 52 era
timeline.text: Modern stories rework her mythic ties while keeping truth at the center.

timeline.title: Cinematic breakthrough
timeline.text: Wonder Woman becomes a global blockbuster and a major superhero milestone.

teamup.title: Justice League founders
teamup.text: Batman brings strategy, Diana brings moral clarity. Their contrast makes them natural allies when the stakes turn global.

moves.special: binds foes with the Lasso of Truth
moves.guard: crosses the bracelets in a shining block

origin: Wonder Woman's origin has shifted across continuities, but the essence remains clear: Diana is an Amazon princess raised to be both a warrior and a diplomat. She leaves Themyscira because the world beyond the island needs truth, courage, and healing.
Her power is rooted in myth, but her mission is human. She enters war zones to end cycles of violence, not to glorify them.
powers: Diana combines divine strength, elite combat training, flight, indestructible bracelets, and the Lasso of Truth. In many stories she is one of the strongest heroes in the DC universe, but her discipline matters as much as raw force.
Her weapons and skills are symbols of authority, but her greatest advantage is the moral clarity she brings into conflict.
storylines: A League of One, The Hiketeia, and modern origin retellings emphasize Diana's role as a protector first and a warrior second. Stories involving Ares and the gods often test whether she can hold onto compassion when the world rewards aggression.
Across eras, Wonder Woman remains most powerful when the narrative gives her both mythic scale and emotional intelligence.
allies: Steve Trevor, the Justice League, the Amazons, Donna Troy, Nubia, and her wider circle give Diana a world beyond battle. They help keep the character connected to community and diplomacy.
She is often the moral center of a team because she can speak with authority without losing warmth.
legacy: Wonder Woman is one of the defining superheroes of the medium. She expanded what a superhero icon could look like and what a heroic voice could sound like.
Her legacy lives in action, but also in the idea that truth is not passive. It is something you stand for, even when it costs you.
funFacts: Wonder Woman first appeared in All Star Comics #8 in 1941.
The Lasso of Truth is one of the most recognizable objects in comics.
She is one of the core DC Trinity alongside Batman and Superman.

trivia.question: What principle most defines Wonder Woman's mission?
trivia.explanation: Truth is at the center of Diana's mythology and her tactics.

trivia.question: Which team is Wonder Woman famously part of as a foundational member?
trivia.explanation: Wonder Woman is a foundational member of the Justice League.

captainamerica.name: Captain America
captainamerica.title: CAPTAIN AMERICA
captainamerica.subtitle: A SHIELD, A PROMISE, AND A WORLD AT WAR
captainamerica.storyLeft: Steve Rogers was a determined underdog long before the serum gave him strength. He kept standing because he believed courage mattered more than size.
captainamerica.storyRight: Captain America turns defense into defiance. He leads with empathy, strategy, and a shield that always comes back when the fight is worth it.

versions.quote: I can do this all day.

villains.name: Red Skull
villains.front: Red Skull turns hate into doctrine and makes Cap fight for the future as much as the present.
villains.back: The rivalry matters because it pits democratic hope against fascist control.

villains.name: Crossbones
villains.front: Crossbones is the ugly, close-range violence that never stops testing Steve's restraint.
villains.back: He matters because he forces Captain America to stay disciplined when chaos gets personal.

timeline.title: First appearance
timeline.text: Captain America debuts as a wartime symbol with a moral center.

timeline.title: Modern return
timeline.text: Steve returns to present-day stories and becomes a leader for a new age.

timeline.title: Civil War
timeline.text: Cap stands against registration and pays the price for principle.

timeline.title: A Man Out of Time
timeline.text: The character becomes a study in legacy, loss, and adaptation.

teamup.title: Disciplined leaders
teamup.text: Steve and T'Challa bring different traditions, but both understand that power means responsibility and restraint.

moves.guard: raises the shield in a perfect block

origin: Steve Rogers volunteered for the Super-Soldier program because he wanted to help in a world at war. The serum changed his body, but his convictions were already in place.
Captain America works because the symbol and the person are aligned. He becomes idealistic without becoming naive.
powers: The serum gives Steve peak physical condition, reflexes, endurance, and recovery far beyond normal human limits. The shield adds precision, protection, and devastating versatility.
His greatest edge is not raw power. It is decision-making under pressure.
storylines: Winter Soldier tests his loyalty, Civil War tests his principles, and modern political stories test whether America deserves the ideals he carries.
His best arcs are never just about fighting. They are about what kind of country or team he is willing to protect.
allies: Bucky Barnes, Peggy Carter, Sam Wilson, Sharon Carter, and the Avengers all frame Steve as someone defined by trust as much as duty.
He works best when the people around him challenge him to stay honest without losing hope.
legacy: Captain America remains one of Marvel's clearest symbols of civic idealism. He is the hero of principles held under pressure.
The character endures because every era can ask whether courage still means the same thing.
funFacts: Captain America first appeared in 1941.
His shield is as much a symbol of protection as offense.
Steve is at his best when he leads by example, not command.

trivia.question: What makes Captain America special beyond his shield?
trivia.explanation: The Super-Soldier Serum gave Steve his enhanced abilities.

trivia.question: Which sidearm is most associated with Captain America?
trivia.explanation: Captain America is defined by his shield.

thor.name: Thor
thor.title: GOD OF THUNDER
thor.subtitle: ROYAL DUTY WITH STORM-SIZED CONSEQUENCES
thor.storyLeft: Thor entered the world as a prince who had to earn humility before he could earn greatness. His story keeps turning on whether power serves pride or protection.
thor.storyRight: He is strongest when thunder becomes mercy. Thor fights like a legend, but he learns like a mortal who has lost too much to waste another chance.

villains.name: Loki
villains.front: Loki turns love, envy, and mischief into a weapon that only family can fully understand.
villains.back: He constantly tests whether Thor's strength includes forgiveness.

villains.name: Hela
villains.front: Hela strips away certainty and forces Thor to define himself without his old symbols.
villains.back: Her arrival reframes him as the god of thunder, not the god of hammers.

timeline.title: First appearance
timeline.text: Thor enters Marvel as a god among heroes.

timeline.title: Earth exile
timeline.text: Worthiness becomes the key to his return and growth.

timeline.title: Ragnarok
timeline.text: The fall of Asgard pushes Thor into reinvention.

timeline.title: Love and Thunder
timeline.text: He rediscovers tenderness while confronting god-level grief.

teamup.title: Lightning in two tempos
teamup.text: Thor brings force while Flash controls pace. Together they overwhelm the field before it can stabilize.

moves.special: calls down a bifrost stormbreaker combo

origin: Thor began as a prince who had to be humbled before he could be trusted with power. His exile to Earth taught him that worthiness is earned through action.
He works as a mythic hero because his growth never feels optional. Every thunderstorm is a character test.
powers: As an Asgardian, Thor commands superhuman strength, durability, and endurance far beyond mortal limits. Mjolnir and Stormbreaker add flight, lightning, and cosmic force.
His greatest ability is not raw damage. It is the ability to stand back up and keep leading when the gods themselves have failed.
storylines: The original hammer era defined him. Ragnarok and Jason Aaron's runs pushed him into mythic reinvention. Love and Thunder leaned into loss, love, and renewed purpose.
Thor stories usually work best when they ask whether a god can remain kind without becoming weak.
allies: Loki, the Avengers, Valkyrie, and the people of New Asgard keep Thor connected to both family and responsibility.
He matters most when he is protecting others rather than proving himself.
legacy: Thor gave Marvel a god-sized hero who still had to learn humility. That contrast keeps the character fresh across decades.
He remains a bridge between fantasy spectacle and emotional vulnerability.
funFacts: Thor first appeared in 1962.
Mjolnir's worthiness enchantment is central to his myth.
Few heroes can make thunder feel noble and personal at once.

trivia.question: What makes Thor worthy of Mjolnir?
trivia.explanation: Mjolnir responds to worthiness, not lineage.

trivia.question: Which realm is Thor most closely tied to?
trivia.explanation: Thor is the prince of Asgard.

hulk.name: Hulk
hulk.title: THE INCREDIBLE HULK
hulk.subtitle: GAMMA RAGE, SURVIVAL, AND UNSTOPPABLE POWER
hulk.storyLeft: Bruce Banner became the Hulk after gamma exposure turned a brilliant scientist into a living contradiction. The monster is also a survival response, which is why the story never stays simple.
hulk.storyRight: Hulk is about the fight between control and release. When Bruce stops trying to suppress every emotion, he becomes a force the world cannot ignore.

villains.name: Abomination
villains.front: Abomination proves that power without restraint becomes a permanent threat.
villains.back: He is the clearest answer to Hulk's question: what happens when rage wins?

villains.name: The Leader
villains.front: The Leader weaponizes intelligence and turns Bruce's own genius into a battlefield.
villains.back: He matters because he shows that intellect without empathy can be monstrous too.

timeline.title: First appearance
timeline.text: The Hulk arrives as a tragic monster with emotional depth.

timeline.title: A TV icon
timeline.text: The live-action era turns Hulk into a mainstream symbol of rage and sympathy.

timeline.title: Planet Hulk
timeline.text: The character gains an epic, gladiatorial scale.

timeline.title: Immortal Hulk
timeline.text: Modern stories lean into horror, myth, and the persistence of trauma.

teamup.title: Mind and monster
teamup.text: Strange handles the impossible structures while Hulk provides the force that breaks through them.

moves.attack: hammers the ground in a gamma surge
moves.special: erupts into a seismic smash combo

origin: Bruce Banner's life changed when gamma exposure merged genius with a second, furious self. The Hulk is both accident and coping mechanism.
The origin works because it asks how much damage a person can contain before the body invents a monster.
powers: Hulk grows stronger as anger rises. He combines overwhelming strength, durability, and healing with a terrifying ability to survive forces that should end him.
He is not just power. He is escalation with a heartbeat.
storylines: Planet Hulk gives him kingdom-scale tragedy. World War Hulk turns his pain outward. Immortal Hulk reframes him as horror, myth, and persistence.
The best Hulk stories let the monster be both threat and victim.
allies: Betty Ross, the Avengers, and Bruce's own scientific work anchor the character beyond the smash.
He is most compelling when people treat the monster like a person first.
legacy: Hulk made emotional volatility into superhero spectacle.
He remains one of Marvel's clearest examples of a hero whose power is inseparable from trauma.
funFacts: The Hulk first appeared in 1962.
Different Hulk eras have explored rage as tragedy, horror, and comedy.
The character always grows when the emotional stakes are personal.

trivia.question: What event created the Hulk?
trivia.explanation: Gamma radiation created the Hulk.

trivia.question: What is Bruce Banner's greatest recurring struggle?
trivia.explanation: Bruce's story is driven by the struggle to control the Hulk.

doctorstrange.name: Doctor Strange
doctorstrange.title: SORCERER SUPREME
doctorstrange.subtitle: THE DOCTOR WHO MADE MAGIC INTO STRATEGY
doctorstrange.storyLeft: Stephen Strange lost the hands that defined his surgical genius and found a larger calling in mysticism. His power comes from discipline, curiosity, and the willingness to accept impossible rules.
doctorstrange.storyRight: Doctor Strange turns magic into a battlefield language. He protects reality by thinking in shapes, dimensions, and consequences other heroes barely see.

versions.quote: By the Hoary Hosts of Hoggoth.

villains.name: Dormammu
villains.front: Dormammu is bigger than direct force and turns Strange's intellect into a survival tool.
villains.back: He matters because Strange's wins often come from outlasting the impossible.

villains.name: Baron Mordo
villains.front: Mordo weaponizes knowledge and turns mentorship into a philosophical grudge.
villains.back: The rivalry stays sharp because it is about the ethics of power, not just the power itself.

timeline.title: First appearance
timeline.text: Doctor Strange debuts as Marvel's doorway into the occult.

timeline.title: Mystic expansion
timeline.text: The character grows into a cornerstone of Marvel's cosmic weirdness.

timeline.title: MCU arrival
timeline.text: Magic gets a sleek cinematic language and a new mainstream audience.

timeline.title: Multiverse fracture
timeline.text: Strange becomes central to reality-spanning consequences.

teamup.title: Calculation on two frequencies
teamup.text: Tony solves the machine and Strange solves the impossible. Together they cover every axis of disaster.

moves.attack: lashes out with a sigil strike
moves.special: folds the arena with eldritch geometry

origin: Stephen Strange began as a brilliant surgeon who lost the hands he depended on. The search for healing led him to the mystic arts and a much bigger responsibility.
The origin works because it replaces ego with discipline and asks what knowledge is for.
powers: Doctor Strange can wield spells, shields, portals, astral projection, and dimensional techniques that make him one of Marvel's most versatile protectors.
His real power is precision. He handles chaos by treating magic like a system.
storylines: Classic Strange stories focus on mystic threats beyond ordinary science. Modern multiverse arcs turn him into the person holding reality together while it tears apart.
His best stories always balance cosmic scale with a very human need to keep the world intact.
allies: Wong, the Avengers, and the Sanctum's guardians keep Strange grounded in responsibility.
He works best when the team trusts him to make the weird call.
legacy: Doctor Strange opened the door for Marvel's supernatural side and made magic feel structured rather than random.
He remains the character you call when physics stops being enough.
funFacts: Doctor Strange first appeared in 1963.
The Eye of Agamotto is among his most recognizable artifacts.
He often wins by knowing the rule before the enemy knows the game.

trivia.question: What title is Doctor Strange known by?
trivia.explanation: Doctor Strange is best known as the Sorcerer Supreme.

trivia.question: What kind of threat is Dormammu to Strange?
trivia.explanation: Dormammu is a dimensional tyrant and one of Strange's greatest mystical threats.

blackpanther.name: Black Panther
blackpanther.title: THE BLACK PANTHER
blackpanther.subtitle: KING OF WAKANDA, STRATEGIST OF THE SHADOWS
blackpanther.storyLeft: T'Challa carries the weight of a throne, a nation, and a legacy that demands both strength and wisdom. He moves like a shadow but rules with careful intent.
blackpanther.storyRight: Black Panther is where heritage meets precision. He protects Wakanda by turning intellect, discipline, and ancestry into one seamless defense.

villains.name: Killmonger
villains.front: Killmonger weaponizes shared history and turns Wakanda's isolation into an accusation.
villains.back: He forces T'Challa to confront the moral cost of protecting paradise alone.

villains.name: Namor
villains.front: Namor is a sovereign threat with grief, principle, and impossible leverage.
villains.back: This rivalry measures diplomacy against vengeance and asks how far a kingdom should go.

timeline.title: First appearance
timeline.text: Black Panther debuts and opens a new chapter in Marvel history.

timeline.title: Civil War arrival
timeline.text: T'Challa enters the spotlight as a poised force of vengeance and restraint.

timeline.title: Wakanda opened
timeline.text: The character becomes a cultural milestone and global icon.

timeline.title: Wakanda Forever
timeline.text: Legacy shifts from one king to a people carrying memory forward.

teamup.title: Brains, resources, and battlefield calm
teamup.text: T'Challa complements Stark's improvisation with discipline. One engineers the future, the other decides how it should be used.

moves.guard: crosses his suit into a vibranium brace

origin: T'Challa inherited the Black Panther mantle and the kingship of Wakanda. His origin ties personal duty to national responsibility.
He stands out because he is both warrior and strategist, never only one or the other.
powers: The heart-shaped herb and vibranium suit enhance T'Challa's strength, speed, senses, and resilience. His claws and suit store and redirect force.
His real power is leadership under pressure.
storylines: Civil War introduces him as a poised avenger. The Black Panther film expands Wakanda's myth. Wakanda Forever turns legacy into a communal responsibility.
Black Panther stories thrive when politics, family, and nationhood all matter at once.
allies: Shuri, Okoye, the Dora Milaje, and the ancestors all frame T'Challa as a ruler who never acts alone.
He is strongest when the kingdom itself is treated as part of the hero's identity.
legacy: Black Panther changed how superhero royalty could be portrayed.
The character remains one of Marvel's clearest intersections of myth, technology, and cultural pride.
funFacts: Black Panther first appeared in 1966.
Wakanda's technology is rooted in vibranium.
The mantle is bigger than any one person.

trivia.question: What metal is central to Black Panther's suit and kingdom?
trivia.explanation: Vibranium powers Wakanda's advanced technology.

trivia.question: Which nation does T'Challa rule?
trivia.explanation: T'Challa is king of Wakanda.

wolverine.name: Wolverine
wolverine.title: WOLVERINE
wolverine.subtitle: FERAL RESOLVE BONDED TO ADAMANTIUM
wolverine.storyLeft: Logan is claws, scars, and survival instinct wrapped around a life he can never fully leave behind. He is at his best when grit becomes a promise to keep going.
wolverine.storyRight: Wolverine is ferocity with a conscience. The rage is real, but so is the refusal to let the worst parts of him win the whole story.

villains.name: Sabretooth
villains.front: Sabretooth turns every Wolverine fight into family trauma with claws out.
villains.back: Victor is the version of Logan who never learned restraint.

villains.name: Weapon X
villains.front: Weapon X is the machinery that turned Logan's body into a battlefield.
villains.back: Sometimes the villain is the institution that stole identity and commodified pain.

timeline.title: First appearance
timeline.text: Wolverine arrives as a feral wildcard in Marvel's expanding world.

timeline.title: X-Men breakout
timeline.text: He becomes the line's most dangerous and popular edge case.

timeline.title: Origins retold
timeline.text: Weapon X history and memory scars move to the center.

timeline.title: Logan
timeline.text: The character reaches a raw, elegiac peak in a future-western finale.

teamup.title: Instinct sharpened by discipline
teamup.text: Wolverine absorbs pressure while Black Panther picks the moment where Logan's ferocity becomes mission-winning leverage.

moves.guard: drops into a low feral defense

origin: Logan's history is tangled with trauma, experiments, and memory damage. Weapon X turned him into a living weapon, but not a willing one.
The origin works because his healing factor keeps the body alive while the past keeps trying to kill the man.
powers: Wolverine's adamantium claws and skeleton make him lethal in close quarters. His healing factor, senses, and stamina let him outlast fights that should end him.
He is a survival engine with a conscience he keeps trying to prove.
storylines: Weapon X defines the horror of his transformation. Old Man Logan and Logan lean into age, guilt, and legacy. X-Men stories keep him in the heart of mutant conflict.
Wolverine works best when the story lets him be both monster and protector.
allies: The X-Men, Jean Grey, Professor X, and even uneasy team-ups give Logan a place to channel the rage.
He is most interesting when found family gives him something to defend.
legacy: Wolverine turned the antihero into a mainstream Marvel icon.
He remains the model for a hero whose violence is always balanced by pain and loyalty.
funFacts: Wolverine first appeared in 1974.
His healing factor makes him nearly impossible to stop for long.
The character's popularity made the X-Men lineup feel dangerous and personal.

trivia.question: What metal coats Wolverine's skeleton?
trivia.explanation: Adamantium is the metal bonded to Wolverine's skeleton.

trivia.question: Which team is Wolverine most famously part of?
trivia.explanation: Wolverine is one of the defining members of the X-Men.

flash.name: The Flash
flash.title: THE FLASH
flash.subtitle: FASTEST MAN ALIVE WITH A HEART THAT OUTRUNS TIME
flash.storyLeft: Barry Allen races through grief, timelines, and impossible rescues. Every choice is measured in microseconds and consequence.
flash.storyRight: The Flash turns velocity into empathy. He is the hero who makes the impossible feel close enough to reach.

villains.name: Reverse-Flash
villains.front: No villain makes heroism feel more intimate and invasive than a speedster who lives to ruin Barry's life.
villains.back: Reverse-Flash weaponizes obsession itself.

villains.name: Zoom
villains.front: Zoom doesn't just chase the Flash. He tries to define what pain should teach him.
villains.back: He treats suffering as a curriculum and forces Barry to reject brutality as growth.

timeline.title: Modern debut
timeline.text: Barry Allen reboots speedster mythology for the Silver Age.

timeline.title: TV breakout
timeline.text: The CW era turns speed into emotional serial storytelling.

timeline.title: Justice League entry
timeline.text: Barry becomes the awkward heartbeat of a world-scale team-up.

timeline.title: Flashpoint cinema
timeline.text: The film doubles down on multiverse consequence and family loss.

teamup.title: One redirects weather, the other redirects time
teamup.text: Flash handles chaos control and impossible saves while Thor turns every opening into thunderous impact.

origin: Barry Allen became the Flash after a lightning accident changed his connection to the Speed Force. His story is built on science, hope, and the weight of mistakes.
The origin works because Barry is both a forensic analyst and a symbol of second chances.
powers: The Speed Force gives Barry speed, phasing, accelerated thought, and the ability to outrun danger itself. He can rescue, repair, and rearrange a battlefield in moments.
His greatest power is the ability to choose compassion at impossible speed.
storylines: Flashpoint remains the key multiverse warning. Rebirth stories focus on legacy and loss. Modern runs keep asking how much a speedster should change the timeline.
Barry's best stories are always about what happens when speed has a heart.
allies: Iris West, Team Flash, and the wider Justice League keep Barry grounded.
He is most compelling when the people he saves are the reason he keeps running.
legacy: The Flash made speed into a full superhero philosophy.
Barry's myth is simple: move fast enough to save, but not so fast that you forget why.
funFacts: Barry Allen first became the Flash in 1956.
The Speed Force is the heart of his myth.
Every Flash story asks what speed costs.

trivia.question: What power source fuels The Flash?
trivia.explanation: The Speed Force powers the Flash.

trivia.question: What is Barry Allen's day job?
trivia.explanation: Barry Allen is a forensic scientist.

aquaman.name: Aquaman
aquaman.title: KING OF ATLANTIS
aquaman.subtitle: TIDE, THRONE, AND TRIDENT
aquaman.storyLeft: Arthur Curry bridges the surface world and the deep sea by living in both. His power is royal, but his responsibility is shared across two worlds.
aquaman.storyRight: Aquaman rules with force when he has to and diplomacy when he can. The ocean is his kingdom, but people are his reason.

villains.name: Black Manta
villains.front: Black Manta turns revenge into a lifelong ocean-spanning vendetta.
villains.back: He matters because he keeps Arthur's past from staying buried.

villains.name: Ocean Master
villains.front: Ocean Master is the brother who turns claim, grievance, and ambition into civil war.
villains.back: Their rivalry asks whether rule comes from blood, strength, or consent.

timeline.title: First appearance
timeline.text: Aquaman enters DC as a sea-bound adventurer.

timeline.title: Royal reinvention
timeline.text: Modern stories turn him into a true king rather than a novelty.

timeline.title: New 52 rebirth
timeline.text: Atlantis becomes central to his identity and scale.

timeline.title: Cinematic tide
timeline.text: The solo film makes Atlantis feel epic, strange, and alive.

teamup.title: Mythic rulers, shared burden
teamup.text: Arthur brings tide-born power while Diana brings moral clarity. Together they balance kingdoms and compassion.

moves.attack: thrusts the trident in a tidal sweep
moves.guard: raises a wall of surging water

origin: Arthur Curry was born between worlds and raised to understand both surface and sea. That dual heritage defines everything about him.
His origin works because he can belong to neither side fully and still protect both.
powers: Aquaman commands sea life, swims at impossible speeds, survives crushing pressure, and wields the trident as both weapon and symbol.
His power is as much authority as muscle.
storylines: Modern stories elevate him from punchline to king. His best arcs deal with identity, sovereignty, and the politics of the ocean.
Aquaman works best when the sea feels like an empire, not a backdrop.
allies: Mera, the Justice League, and Atlantis itself keep Arthur grounded in responsibility.
He is strongest when diplomacy and duty move together.
legacy: Aquaman's reputation changed because stories gave him scale and seriousness.
He now stands as DC's bridge between mythic spectacle and environmental power.
funFacts: Aquaman first appeared in 1941.
He can communicate with sea life in many continuities.
The trident is both crown and weapon.

trivia.question: Where does Aquaman rule?
trivia.explanation: Aquaman is king of Atlantis.

trivia.question: What element is most closely tied to Aquaman's power?
trivia.explanation: Water and the sea define Aquaman's myth.

greenlantern.name: Green Lantern
greenlantern.title: GREEN LANTERN
greenlantern.subtitle: WILLPOWER MADE VISIBLE
greenlantern.storyLeft: Hal Jordan turns courage and imagination into a weapon against cosmic scale. The ring only works when his will stays sharper than fear.
greenlantern.storyRight: Green Lantern is a hero of creativity under pressure. He makes belief visible and then uses it to defend a sector that never sleeps.

villains.name: Sinestro
villains.front: Sinestro proves that order without empathy becomes a trap.
villains.back: He matters because he is what Hal could become if fear wins.

villains.name: Parallax
villains.front: Parallax is fear given shape, scale, and cosmic appetite.
villains.back: The rivalry turns willpower into a literal survival test.

timeline.title: First appearance
timeline.text: Green Lantern starts as a Golden Age idea before evolving into cosmic law.

timeline.title: Hal Jordan arrives
timeline.text: The Silver Age rings in the modern Corps mythology.

timeline.title: Rebirth
timeline.text: The character's identity and myth are rebuilt around willpower.

timeline.title: Cosmic legacy
timeline.text: The Corps expands into one of DC's biggest space epics.

teamup.title: Hope and willpower
teamup.text: Superman inspires belief while Green Lantern turns belief into tangible form.

moves.guard: wraps the ring in a hard-light shield

origin: Hal Jordan was chosen by a power ring because his will and fearlessness made him fit for the Corps. The ring is a test as much as a gift.
Green Lantern works because imagination and discipline must be equal partners.
powers: A Green Lantern ring creates hard-light constructs, flight, force fields, and almost any shape the wielder can focus into existence.
The weakness is not the ring. It is doubt.
storylines: Sinestro Corps War and Blackest Night turned the Lantern myth into cosmic event storytelling. Rebirth rebuilt Hal around courage rather than recklessness.
The best Lantern stories ask what someone can imagine when fear is the obstacle.
allies: The Green Lantern Corps, the Justice League, and fellow Lanterns keep Hal connected to a larger mission.
He is strongest when he acts like a guardian, not a hotshot.
legacy: Green Lantern gave DC a hero powered by will and creativity rather than brute force.
The concept remains one of the clearest superhero metaphors for belief under pressure.
funFacts: The Green Lantern oath is one of comics' most famous lines.
The Corps spans the universe in many continuities.
Willpower is treated as a literal force in Lantern mythology.

trivia.question: What power fuels a Green Lantern ring?
trivia.explanation: Willpower powers the ring.

trivia.question: What is the Corps' role in the universe?
trivia.explanation: The Green Lantern Corps acts as a galactic peacekeeping force.

nightwing.name: Nightwing
nightwing.title: NIGHTWING
nightwing.subtitle: THE LEADER WHO LEARNED TO FLY SOLO
nightwing.storyLeft: Dick Grayson grew from circus acrobat to Robin and then into a hero strong enough to build a name of his own. He is proof that legacy can become independence without losing heart.
nightwing.storyRight: Nightwing moves with confidence, humor, and a rare kind of warmth. He protects Bludhaven by being the kind of leader who can still jump first.

villains.name: Deathstroke
villains.front: Deathstroke tests whether Dick can outthink someone built for precision violence.
villains.back: The rivalry matters because it forces leadership to stay personal.

villains.name: Blockbuster
villains.front: Blockbuster turns Bludhaven's streets into a test of endurance and nerve.
villains.back: He matters because Nightwing's city is as important as Gotham is to Batman.

timeline.title: Robin origins
timeline.text: Dick Grayson enters the myth as the first Robin.

timeline.title: Nightwing debut
timeline.text: He steps out of Batman's shadow and claims his own identity.

timeline.title: Bludhaven guardian
timeline.text: Nightwing grows into a city-scale protector.

timeline.title: Bat-Family leader
timeline.text: He becomes the clearest bridge between legacy and independence.

teamup.title: Legacy with a pulse
teamup.text: Batman built the foundation. Nightwing proves the mission can evolve without losing its edge.

moves.attack: whips through with an escrima rush
moves.guard: drops into a spinning staff block

origin: Dick Grayson began as Robin after tragedy pushed him into Batman's orbit. He later claimed the Nightwing identity as a statement of independence.
His origin works because he becomes a leader without rejecting where he came from.
powers: Nightwing relies on elite acrobatics, martial arts, stealth, and improvised gear rather than powers. He wins by movement and confidence.
His charisma is part of the toolkit.
storylines: Nightwing stories often focus on leadership, trust, and the weight of living in Batman's shadow. Bludhaven gives him a city that belongs to him.
The best arcs let him be the heart of the Bat-Family without reducing him to sidekick history.
allies: The Bat-Family, Titans, and close relationships like Barbara Gordon keep Dick grounded.
He thrives when his optimism is treated as strength, not softness.
legacy: Nightwing is the proof that a sidekick can become an icon without losing the original appeal.
He remains one of DC's most beloved characters because he feels fully grown and still hopeful.
funFacts: Nightwing debuted in 1984.
Dick Grayson was the first Robin.
His blue emblem became a signature look for sleek heroism.

trivia.question: What was Nightwing's first heroic identity?
trivia.explanation: Dick Grayson began as Robin.

trivia.question: Which city is Nightwing most closely tied to?
trivia.explanation: Bludhaven is Nightwing's home base.

martianmanhunter.name: Martian Manhunter
martianmanhunter.title: MARTIAN MANHUNTER
martianmanhunter.subtitle: LAST SON OF MARS, GUARDIAN OF TWO WORLDS
martianmanhunter.storyLeft: J'onn J'onzz is an exile who lost his home world and rebuilt his purpose on Earth. He carries grief quietly, then uses it to protect others from the same loss.
martianmanhunter.storyRight: Martian Manhunter is a guardian who sees more than most heroes ever can. His calm hides the ache of being the last witness to a dead world.

villains.name: M'comm
villains.front: M'comm turns species conflict into personal grief and keeps J'onn's past alive.
villains.back: He matters because he weaponizes what J'onn lost.

villains.name: Lobo
villains.front: Lobo is the loud, destructive opposite of J'onn's quiet restraint.
villains.back: The rivalry works because it pits cosmic patience against pure chaos.

timeline.title: First appearance
timeline.text: Martian Manhunter arrives as one of DC's earliest sci-fi heroes.

timeline.title: Justice League core
timeline.text: He becomes a foundational League member and strategic anchor.

timeline.title: Identity deepens
timeline.text: Stories lean into exile, grief, and belonging.

timeline.title: Telepathic sentinel
timeline.text: J'onn remains one of DC's most quietly essential protectors.

teamup.title: Two guardians, one planet
teamup.text: Clark inspires hope while J'onn brings patience, strategy, and a second alien perspective.

moves.attack: strikes with a phased telekinetic blow
moves.guard: melds into an intangible defensive veil

origin: J'onn J'onzz is the last surviving Martian in many continuities, exiled to Earth after tragedy destroyed his home. His arrival turns loneliness into guardianship.
The origin works because he chooses compassion even after losing almost everything.
powers: Martian Manhunter can shapeshift, fly, phase, and read minds, making him one of DC's most versatile heroes.
His power is immense, but his restraint is what keeps him heroic.
storylines: Justice League stories make him the quiet stabilizer. Solo stories often focus on alienation, memory, and finding a home.
He shines when the story lets him be the heart of a team without making him loud.
allies: The Justice League, Superman, and the people who accept J'onn as family give him purpose on Earth.
He values connection because he has lost a world already.
legacy: Martian Manhunter remains one of DC's most emotionally rich science-fiction heroes.
He proves that empathy can be just as powerful as force.
funFacts: Martian Manhunter first appeared in 1955.
He is often one of the League's most powerful members.
Identity and belonging are core to his myth.

trivia.question: What species is Martian Manhunter?
trivia.explanation: J'onn J'onzz is a Martian.

trivia.question: Which power is most associated with Martian Manhunter?
trivia.explanation: Martian Manhunter is famous for telepathy.

daredevil.name: Daredevil
daredevil.title: THE MAN WITHOUT FEAR
daredevil.subtitle: JUSTICE DOES NOT NEED TO SEE TO STAND
daredevil.storyLeft: A childhood chemical accident blinded Matt Murdock and heightened his remaining senses. He grew into a lawyer who defends his neighborhood in court and, as Daredevil, on its rooftops.
daredevil.storyRight: Matt lives between the law he believes in and the violence he uses to protect it. Every victory asks whether justice can survive the methods chosen in its name.

villains.name: Kingpin
villains.front: Wilson Fisk makes corruption look respectable. Matt challenges a system that can buy almost everything except his surrender.
villains.back: The conflict turns a city's institutions into a battlefield.

timeline.title: First appearance
timeline.text: Daredevil #1

timeline.title: The turning point

timeline.title: Signature abilities
timeline.text: Daredevil combines sensory awareness with disciplined movement. His billy clubs and close combat training make a narrow corridor as dangerous as an open rooftop.

timeline.title: The enduring question
timeline.text: His stories bring superhero stakes down to a neighborhood, where protecting one person can matter as much as saving the world.

trivia.explanation: Daredevil's identity is Matt Murdock.

blackwidow.name: Black Widow
blackwidow.title: THE ELUSIVE AVENGER
blackwidow.subtitle: A PAST REWRITTEN THROUGH EVERY CHOICE
blackwidow.storyLeft: Natasha Romanoff was trained in the Red Room to become a covert weapon. She eventually rejected that role, working with S.H.I.E.L.D. and the Avengers to choose a different future.
blackwidow.storyRight: Natasha's strength is the ability to act with purpose after a life shaped by other people's orders. Redemption is a practice, not a clean slate.

villains.name: The Red Room
villains.front: Natasha fights a training apparatus that treats people as equipment.
villains.back: Escaping its influence means reclaiming the right to make her own decisions.

timeline.text: Tales of Suspense #52

timeline.title: The turning point
timeline.text: Natasha Romanoff was trained in the Red Room to become a covert weapon. She eventually rejected that role, working with S.H.I.E.L.D. and the Avengers to choose a different future.

timeline.title: The enduring question
timeline.text: She brings the intelligence of a spy to a team of icons, proving that careful judgment can change a battle before it begins.

captainmarvel.name: Captain Marvel
captainmarvel.title: EARTH'S COSMIC CHAMPION
captainmarvel.subtitle: THE SKY WAS ONLY THE BEGINNING
captainmarvel.storyLeft: Pilot Carol Danvers became entangled with the Kree and developed extraordinary powers. Her journey through several heroic identities eventually led her to carry the Captain Marvel name.
captainmarvel.storyRight: Carol meets impossible odds with the conviction of a pilot who refuses to abandon her mission. Leadership also asks her to recognize when certainty needs a second opinion.

villains.name: Yon-Rogg
villains.front: Yon-Rogg connects Carol's personal history to the reach of the Kree military.
villains.back: Their rivalry makes autonomy as important as raw power.

timeline.title: First appearance
timeline.text: Marvel Super-Heroes #13 (Carol Danvers)

timeline.title: The turning point
timeline.text: Pilot Carol Danvers became entangled with the Kree and developed extraordinary powers. Her journey through several heroic identities eventually led her to carry the Captain Marvel name.

timeline.title: Signature abilities
timeline.text: Carol absorbs and projects energy, flies at tremendous speed, and withstands forces far beyond human limits. Her experience gives that power direction.

timeline.title: The enduring question
timeline.text: Captain Marvel connects the Avengers' defense of Earth with the wider cosmic frontier, taking responsibility beyond familiar skies.

scarletwitch.name: Scarlet Witch
scarletwitch.title: THE CHAOS MAGICIAN
scarletwitch.subtitle: WHEN FEELING CAN RESHAPE THE WORLD
scarletwitch.storyLeft: Wanda Maximoff first stood alongside the Brotherhood with her brother Pietro before joining the Avengers. Her evolving connection to witchcraft placed her at the center of reality-changing conflicts.
scarletwitch.storyRight: Wanda's history crosses heroism, loss, and devastating mistakes. This dossier follows her heroic identity while recognizing that immense power never removes the need for accountability.

villains.name: Chthon
villains.front: Chthon represents a predatory connection to the magical forces surrounding Wanda.
villains.back: The struggle places ownership of her power and identity at stake.

timeline.title: First appearance
timeline.text: X-Men #4

timeline.title: The turning point
timeline.text: Wanda Maximoff first stood alongside the Brotherhood with her brother Pietro before joining the Avengers. Her evolving connection to witchcraft placed her at the center of reality-changing conflicts.

timeline.title: Signature abilities
timeline.text: Wanda's magic can disrupt probability and reshape reality. Control and understanding matter as much as the scale of what she can change.

timeline.title: The enduring question
timeline.text: Her stories ask what healing means when someone has the ability to rewrite the pain rather than live through it.

antman.name: Ant-Man
antman.title: THE SMALL-SCALE GIANT
antman.subtitle: A SECOND CHANCE AT EVERY SIZE
antman.storyLeft: Scott Lang stole Hank Pym's Ant-Man equipment to help save his daughter Cassie. That desperate act became the beginning of a second chance as a superhero.
antman.storyRight: Scott is driven by a personal promise before any grand destiny. His ingenuity makes overlooked spaces and unlikely plans into openings that bigger heroes miss.

villains.name: Darren Cross
villains.front: Cross turns scientific opportunity toward control and profit.
villains.back: Scott's protective motives form the counterweight to that ambition.

timeline.title: First appearance
timeline.text: Avengers #181 (Scott Lang)

timeline.title: The turning point
timeline.text: Scott Lang stole Hank Pym's Ant-Man equipment to help save his daughter Cassie. That desperate act became the beginning of a second chance as a superhero.

timeline.title: Signature abilities
timeline.text: Pym-particle technology lets Scott alter his size. His helmet coordinates with ants, while his technical skills turn unusual environments into an advantage.

timeline.text: A Holocaust survivor and powerful mutant, Magneto is determined that his people will never face extermination. His response to persecution repeatedly brings him into conflict with the X-Men.

timeline.title: Signature abilities
timeline.text: Magneto shapes magnetic forces, moving metal and generating formidable defenses. His abilities operate on a scale far beyond throwing objects.

timeline.title: The enduring question
timeline.text: He gives the X-Men's struggle an ideological fault line, where shared hopes for mutant survival lead toward sharply different futures.

greengoblin.name: Green Goblin
greengoblin.title: THE NIGHTMARE ABOVE NEW YORK
greengoblin.subtitle: THE MASK MAKES THE AMBITION VISIBLE
greengoblin.storyLeft: Industrialist Norman Osborn became the Green Goblin after exposure to an experimental formula. Corporate ambition acquired superhuman strength, a weaponized glider, and a terrifying public face.
greengoblin.storyRight: Osborn attacks the connections that let Peter Parker keep being Spider-Man. The rivalry is dangerous because the threat reaches beyond a costume into ordinary life.

villains.name: Spider-Man
villains.front: Peter Parker's concern for others is the vulnerability Norman keeps trying to exploit.
villains.back: Spider-Man's answer is to keep caring despite that cost.
